Self-hosted woff2 subsets from @fontsource 5.x (SIL OFL 1.1, licences beside them).
Baloo 2 (titles), Nunito 400-800 (children's reading text), Baloo Bhaijaan 2 (Arabic UI fallback),
Amiri (Arabic prose, scripture-adjacent text and dua), Amiri Quran (ayat), Aref Ruqaa (calligraphy panel titles).
@font-face rules live at the top of UI/styles.css (Illuminated Page v2, UI/DESIGN.md).
